feature: weighted-round-robin child policy inside ordinary Channel weighted_target
decision: accepted per-RPC ORCA support with explicit OOB fallback boundary

contracts: weighted_target delegates only to the selected READY child picker
every WRR policy instance owns its scheduler snapshot and sequence
ORCA reports update the endpoint using the selected child config
missing, blacked-out, or expired weights fall back to child-local round robin
single-owner ordinary Channel does not create a hidden OOB stream

implementation.ownership: each leaf owns config, scheduler, sequence and deep-copied custom metric names
implementation.filtering: scheduler rebuild and pick include only reusable slots under the leaf hierarchical prefix
implementation.per_rpc_orca: unary trailers update the selected slot with its matching leaf config
implementation.lifecycle: disconnect generations invalidate stale scheduler entries and address replacement clears every leaf snapshot
implementation.expiration: weight expiration rebuilds an empty snapshot and delegates to leaf-local round robin
implementation.oob_boundary: enableOobLoadReport disables per-RPC learning and deliberately remains round robin because ordinary Channel owns no background stream
implementation.failure: scheduler allocation failure propagates OutOfMemory instead of silently changing policy

native_cases: matching endpoints a and b publish per-RPC ORCA weights 1 and 3
a READY outside endpoint advertises weight 100 but never enters the leaf scheduler or receives a pick
200 learned picks keep b between 60 and 90 percent
after reports stop and expire, 40 calls split exactly 20 to 20
an OOB-configured leaf performs 40 exact alternating calls without opening a hidden report stream
ServiceConfig is destroyed immediately after both Channel initializations
custom metric-name ownership and recursive runtime construction pass every induced allocation failure

negative_boundary.hostname_targets: ordinary weighted-target remains limited to static resolved endpoints

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC ordinary weighted target WRR' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC ordinary weighted target OOB WRR' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC ordinary weighted target' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='ordinary weighted target runtime deep copy' --summary all
remaining_gap: ordinary outlier wrappers, hostname runtime support and dynamic service-config child retention remain before broad parity
